items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was older than Nicodemus. Oh, yeah, oh, yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] He was a man when we were kids.

ctx.x: Did that have a special rhythm? No, like a piano, you know. I guess, I swear it must have had in it I guess. But you turn it with your hand, you see. And they just go from corner to corner, catch the spots like that, this corner's the saloon. They play three pieces for nickels, see. You'd give them a nickel and they'd play your three numbers. Well, all right, he'd go to the next corner, they'd have anybody going to music. Now he'd play one number just to draw the people, you understand, see. Then the guy come out…
He was older than Nicodemus. Oh, yeah, oh, yeah.
He was a man when we were kids.
